summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a multiplayer dark-fantasy MMO spanning Lantern's March, race homelands, a battleground, and gate-linked dungeon/raid places. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm, persistence and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors, shared registries and data-driven combat cores run world systems, while procedural generators and Awakening supply presentation, water and creator-facing controls.
places: places/main/ - 136-cell streamed Lantern's March; config and sim own terrain, weather/day-night, room weather and Party Finder.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach and Hall of Banners, merchants, guild registrar, farms and routes; Lantern Stall sign, jar and stag display sit here, with the stall checkout script.
places/main/cells/ neighboring scenes - March woods, race-town beds, quest regions and landmarks; x0z-1 holds qm-ward-census, and x2z12 holds Gull's Wake/Captain Merrow.
places/banner-vale/ - 5v5 capture-the-banner battleground; referee sim owns teams, flags, scores and returns; Awakening ground, grass and sky.
places/{hollowcrypt,drowned-bell,root-archive,pale-choir,emberheart,ninth-assembly}/ - gate-linked dungeon/raid instances with shared instance/boss systems and place-selected lighting/render looks.
places/{character-creation-land,main-menu-land}/ - character-creation and menu environments, with ray-traced looks and separate atmosphere/reflection tuning.
places/main-menu-land/ - default arrival/menu place; MMORPG menu owns realm roster and character selection before routing into creation or gameplay.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaults to main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing, realm pulse, Awakening lighting and three buyable offers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-main-menu.js - menu/roster UI; entry for realm and character selection.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, class, quest, vendor, guild, guild-flag, trades, flight, vitality, cursor-free, region-music and mount behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera; MMORPG owns separate menu and character-creation camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/sim.js - March terrain, Awakening grass/look, atmosphere/day-night cycle, room weather and Party Finder.
mods/awakening/mod.json - registers the Awakening guide tab and attaches input.js to player and god; panel.js renders the handbook.
mods/wow-camera-controls/mod.json - attaches camera.js to camera; move.js is an optional drop-in replacement for the world's movement behavior, not an additional movement attachment.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency, shops, soundtrack and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors and gameplay scripts.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character persistence, roster population and realm list/detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/player-panel-input.js - in-world panel actions; player.js lazily imports it after world entry; uses shop-data.js, profession-data.js and scripts/lib/talents.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-zone-splash.js - stable per-day zone art and arrival veil shared by creation loading and in-world arrival.
scripts/lib/places.js and scripts/lib/regions.js - PLAY/isPlay/SAFE_HOME and REGIONS/MARCH/regionAt registries reused by quests, class actions, vitality, flight and regional music/HUD.
scripts/lib/kit.js and scripts/lib/talents.js - shared combat/targeting/talent-derived math; class cores, panel input, quest-player and sheet consume them.
mods/awakening/lib/swell.js - common wind/squall/storm swell math read by water materials and the waves manager; lib/waves.js supplies floating-body force math.
mods/wow-camera-controls/lib/config.js and lib/motion.js - shared camera/body tuning and movement intent used by camera.js and move.js.
notableExports: scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY, isPlay, SAFE_HOME; scripts/gen/instance.js - LAYOUTS, roomsOf, geometry.
scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt; scripts/lib/refuge.js - REFUGES, inRefuge.
scripts/lib/kit.js - power, haste, gearPower, classOf, canAct, forward, alive, aimPoint, softTargets, launch, materialOf, meleeFoley.
scripts/lib/talents.js - TREES, LEVEL_PER_POINT, MAX_POINTS, classKey, pointsEarned, picks, pointsFree, talentFx, fxText, canPick.
scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}-core.js - class actions; arcanist-core.js additionally exports callStar and starLands; scripts/lib/missiles.js exports MISSILES and impactFx.
scripts/lib/sheet.js - sheetOf; scripts/flight-core.js - updateSchedule, onInput, update; scripts/vitality-core.js - bloodEnds, blessEnds, onInput, updateSchedule, update.
scripts/mount.js - onSpawn, onInput, updateSchedule, update; scripts/lantern-stall.js - onSpawn; scripts/buyables/{stag,cloak,tip}.js - onPurchase.

mods/awakening/lib/guide.js - PAGES, SWITCHES; lib/shots.js - SHOTS; lib/swell.js - shared swell/squall functions; lib/waves.js - WAVES, stokes, floatPoints, heave; mods/wow-camera-controls/lib/config.js exports CAMERA, MOVE, SWIM.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent, velocity/footstep state, arrival _areaReady stamp and jump/landing/footstep sounds.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including professions, inventory, equipment, quest state and trained rank.
MMORPG player.js - save-in-flight/retry guards and confirmed-save fingerprint; SQL and legacy roster-storage completion gate save completion.
scripts/lib/talents.js - tree definitions, pick validation and derived effects; character state.unlockedTalents stores spec:tier picks, with points derived from level.
scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}-core.js - class action/cooldown state and combat effects; wrappers lazily load and forward to matching cores.
mods/awakening/input.js - editor awOpen/awPage/awFlash and optional world switch changes; mirrors active Awakening settings into world.state.awakening for panel.js.
mods/awakening/waves.js - per-tick heave/drift forces on tagged floating bodies; water-surface.js and river-surface.js own their ripple slots and effects.

scripts/mount.js - transient player.state.mounted, session cloak reference, mount/rider linkage and ride behavior; platform owns durable player.state.purchases. scripts/flight-core.js and scripts/region-music.js own flight/map and per-session music state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu/instance gates stamp allowed transitions and routing validates requested room and saved return.

main-menu-mgr loads current-room SQL roster; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; realms.yml feeds routing.js and realm-pulse cron, which writes realm_pulse for realm-save to read.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert characters keyed by user, realm and slot.
Creation confirm → character-select.js loadingScreen/progress → ui-zone-splash.js arrival veil; it waits for scripts/player.js _areaReady after stable grounded terrain contact.

templates/player.js behavior order → locomotion → movement → class handlers → quest-player → vendor → guild → guild-flag → trades → flight → vitality → cursor-free → region-music → mount; MMORPG player.js/wow-move.js consume movement/camera state.
MMORPG player.js dynamically imports lib/player-panel-input.js after a created hero enters a non-meta place; panel module uses shop-data.js, profession-data.js and scripts/lib/talents.js.
ui-menu-panel.js renders talents and character sheet from talents.js/sheet.js → player-panel-input.js handles spend/reset → state.unlockedTalents; class cores/kit and quest-player derive effects.
Class wrappers lazily load matching cores; HUD maps spell slots to per-class action ids; class cores and missile effects produce action/impact FX.
scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml definitions → boss-core.js; boss melee hitFx emits impact FX, cameraPunch/hitstop and swing/hit sounds from the same definition.

Awakening panel.js taps send awOp actions → attached input.js on player/god mutates editor switches and world.state.awakening → handbook reflects settings; wave manager reads shared swell/wind and floaters, writes forces and emits awakening effects.

Lantern Stall sign ui:stag/ui:cloak/ui:tip → scripts/lantern-stall.js proposes checkout → world.config.yaml buyables/platform callbacks record player.state.purchases; mount.js reads ownership, handles mountToggle to call/dismiss the session stag, and outfits an owned cloak.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/instance.js - reused across instance places, varied by layout (room dimensions, corridor length, materials/colors) and kind; floor roughness is layout-specific for traced reflections.

scripts/boss-core.js + scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml - one AI across dungeon/raid and open-world placements, varied by definition: hp, arena, abilities/telegraphs, phases, enrage, rewards, model, scale and optional animation/sounds.
scripts/gen/flora.js - seeded flora across March roads, race-town beds, Reedhaven cottage gardens and Thornhollow bloom clearings; kind, palette, seed, scale and density vary.
scripts/gen/house.js - generated cottages/halls share house geometry with width/depth, roof, chimney and window parameters; cottage weathering/detail differs from stone halls.
scripts/gen/homeland.js - landmarks/foliage reused at homeland encounter sites, varied by kind (hollow, vault, reedcage, bloom), scale and seed.
scripts/gen/{ashen,ashen-village,grave-ground}.js - Ashen Close graveyard, cathedral yard, gothic village pieces and cover; helper, kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary.
scripts/gen/fen.js and scripts/gen/tree.js + scripts/tree-look.js - seeded marsh props/boardwalks and March pines/oaks/dead trees recur across regions; kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary.

mods/awakening water materials/surfaces - shared swell, wakes, ripples, foam and storm logic reused by lakes, rivers, creeks and falls; placement params supply level, flow, wind and optional squall/storm settings.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/grave-weeds.js - no scene or other package reference; graveyard cover is currently placed through grave-ground.js instead.
migrationNotes: Adding a playable place requires a row in scripts/lib/places.js PLAY; dying heroes rise at SAFE_HOME for listed dungeons/raids. Quest and class logic uses isPlay rather than hard-coded place names.

Instance room walls/corridors and scene furnishing placement share layout coordinates: entry is z=0, chambers chain toward -Z, floor y=0; keep scripts/gen/instance.js roomsOf arithmetic consistent with scenes.
Gate links are explicit +place#object links on paired gates; instance-gate checks minLevel and active enterQuest, stamps _worldEnterAt for arrival.js, then counts enterTally.

Creation and first-arrival veils use ui-zone-splash.js zoneArtFor/arrivalVeil; scripts/player.js stamps _areaReady after stable grounded terrain contact and splash retains its wait/hold/fade contract.
Talent picks are state.unlockedTalents entries keyed spec:tier, not flat tier numbers; points derive from floor(level/5), max 12, with one pick per tier in a spec.

mods/wow-camera-controls/move.js owns body velocity/yaw: use it instead of, never beside, the world's movement writer; mount rides ctx.session.walk intent. scripts/mount.js recognizes the bare mountToggle input.pressed/actions key (not the MMORPG-namespaced alias); Awakening float forces and visible swell share lib/swell.js math.
